scope: Targeted confirmation of the six default and six algebraic fixtures after alternating shared-hot, structural-cancellation and algebraic wide-256 observations measured +9.06, +8.29 and +10.50 percent, while the separate trials measured -5.09, -3.49 and -0.78 percent. Supplemental alternating-order timing of retained executables produced by the frozen baseline/candidate harnesses. Executable bytes are hashed before and after every process. Baseline hashes additionally match the prior v1100 paired candidate record. The frozen harnesses bind source and library identities; their original cost summaries do not contain executable hashes. This is an additional local timing observation, not a replacement for original trials or an allocation/binary-size/whole-program claim.
